presentation.question: How does bar position change a squat?

required_checks: Map external loading to the actual support region; front and back racks must not load only the hands.
Fit the shaft radius to the displayed surfaces, including posterior racks and elbow creases.
Verify flat-foot support, friction and zero root reserve across the entire cycle.
Let posture follow geometry, balance and stated motion criteria; do not assign a fixed muscle-dominance ranking.
Validate each upper-body rack and arm range before interpreting muscle forces.
Do not infer local skin pressure, pain or injury risk from elbow contact resultants.

sources.use: Matched load, stance and depth matter; high/low bar kinematic differences were small in this particular experiment. EMG is not used as force data.
Load-placement comparison; participants adjusted posture, and most lower-limb moments were similar across conditions. Not a Zercher validation.
Technique reference; not experimental validation of the proposed Zercher force model.
